description: This file contains the code-behind for the user registration page in an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages web application, implementing user registration, email confirmation, and sign-in logic.

classes.name: RegisterModel
classes.description: PageModel for handling user registration logic, including creating users, generating email confirmation tokens, and signing in users.

classes.name: RegisterModel.InputModel
classes.description: Data transfer object representing the registration form inputs: Email, Password, ConfirmPassword.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests; initializes return URL for redirection post-registration.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests to register a new user, create email confirmation, sign-in, and handle errors.
